* Arrival in Koh Samui and check-in at your chosen hotel or resort.

* In the afternoon, visit the Big Buddha statue at Wat Phra Yai and take in the stunning views from the hilltop.

* Spend the morning exploring the island's local markets and shops, where you can find souvenirs, handicrafts, and local products.
* In the afternoon, visit the Tiger Kingdom Koh Samui, where you can get up close and personal with tigers of different ages and sizes.
* In the evening, enjoy a farewell dinner at one of the island's many restaurants or bars.
